CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository hosts the Community Applications templates for **TorrentNG**, a modern torrent management stack built for headless power-user seeding at scale (10k-100k+ torrents, 200-500+ TB).
Two templates are provided:
- **torrentng-webui** -- a replacement WebUI/API for an rTorrent, qBittorrent, Transmission, or Deluge install you already run. No built-in torrent engine; it fronts your existing client. - **torrentng** -- the full first-party stack: `torrentngd`, TorrentNG's own Rust BitTorrent client daemon, with its built-in WebUI/API and no external client dependency.
Both ship a qBittorrent-compatible API so Prowlarr, Sonarr, Radarr, autobrr, and cross-seed keep working unchanged.
Source, issues, and documentation: https://github.com/snapetech/TorrentNG
